lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots, spaced in a quasi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a lattice-like arrangement where spots act as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity light gradient on the dorsal edge and a low-intensity shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin, positioned in the lower-right foreground, exhibits a higher density of smaller, more concentrated high-luminance blobs relative to the larger, more spaced pattern on the lateral flank.
